rot.ideia.ex1.e1: Zugzwang is a German word: obligation to move.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: Sometimes every move makes the position worse. Even so, you must move.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: You are White. Take the opposition: Black is left to move and their king has to give way.
rot.ideia.ex1.p: Put Black in zugzwang, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: That's right! Kings face to face, and Black has to move: zugzwang.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The king goes to e6, face to face with the black king. Now Black has to give way.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.d6c7.1: That move hands the turn to Black, but with no zugzwang.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.d6c7.2: The black king defends well and holds the draw.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.d6c6.1: That move hands the turn to Black, but with no zugzwang.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.d6c6.2: The black king defends well and holds the draw.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.d6d5.1: That move hands the turn to Black, but with no zugzwang.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.d6d5.2: The black king defends well and holds the draw.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.d6c5.1: That move hands the turn to Black, but with no zugzwang.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.d6c5.2: The black king defends well and holds the draw.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.e5e6.1: That move hands the turn to Black, but with no zugzwang.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.e5e6.2: The black king defends well and holds the draw.
rot.ideia.ex1.volta: Put Black in zugzwang, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.livre.fala: Play on from here against the machine and see what happens.
rot.ideia.ex1.livre.volta: Let's go back to the position and look for the zugzwang.
rot.ideia.ex1.fins.afogado: Stalemate: Black had no move. It is a draw.
rot.ideia.ex1.fins.repeticao: The position repeated: the black king held the square in front of the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: The black king has to move and leaves the pawn's path.
rot.ideia.ex1.l2: The white king steps aside and guards the pawn's path.
rot.ideia.ex1.l3: Remember: zugzwang forces the opponent to open the door.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: Now as Black. Zugzwang can also turn against the attacker.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: Stay on the pawn's file, in front of it. If your king has no move, without check, it is stalemate.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: Stay in front of the pawn, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! The king stays in front of the pawn, on the promotion square.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The king goes to e8, in front of the pawn. It does not leave from there.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.d8e7.1: That holds too! The king stops the pawn head on.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.d8e7.2: Look also at e8: from there the king waits for stalemate.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.d8c8.1: The king moves away from the pawn's path.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.d8c8.2: The white king gets close to the promotion square, and the pawn will promote.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.d8c7.1: The king moves away from the pawn's path.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.d8c7.2: The white king gets close to the promotion square, and the pawn will promote.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: Stay in front of the pawn, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.livre.fala: Play on from here against the machine and see what happens.
rot.ideia.ex2.livre.volta: Let's go back to the position and look for the zugzwang.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: The black king takes the opposition.
rot.ideia.ex2.l3: Remember: when defending, stay in front of the pawn. Stalemate can save you.
rot.ideia.ex2.l4: Now I will show the zugzwang that lets the pawn promote and the stalemate that saves.
rot.demos.obrigacao.e1: Black has to move, and there is only one move: going to c7.
rot.demos.obrigacao.l1: The black king leaves, because it must.
rot.demos.obrigacao.l2: The white king guards the promotion square.
rot.demos.obrigacao.l3: Nothing stops the pawn from promoting. Zugzwang opened the door.
rot.demos.afogamento.e1: Now zugzwang turns against White: they push the pawn too early.
rot.demos.afogamento.l2: The black king goes in front of the pawn.
rot.demos.afogamento.l3: The white king protects the pawn.
rot.demos.afogamento.l4: Black has no move, and there is no check: stalemate, a draw.
rot.demos.afogamento.l5: To avoid stalemate, the attacking king gets in front of the pawn before it advances.
rot.demos.afogamento.l6: Now it's your turn: play against the machine and use zugzwang.
rot.pratica.ataque.enunciado: As White: put Black in zugzwang and take the pawn to promotion.
rot.pratica.ataque.fim: Well done. Zugzwang opened the door and the pawn promoted.
rot.pratica.defesa.enunciado: As Black: hold the draw. Stay in front of the pawn and take the opposition.
rot.pratica.defesa.fim: Draw secured. The black king held the square in front of the pawn.
